panels.allHidden: All panels are hidden. Choose what you want to see.

code.lockedBody: To change it, move the blocks. If you prefer to write the code yourself, switch the project to code.

codeApi.pinMode: Sets a pin as input or output.
codeApi.digitalWrite: Turns a pin on (HIGH) or off (LOW).
codeApi.digitalRead: Reads whether a pin is HIGH or LOW.
codeApi.analogRead: Reads a voltage as a number from 0 to 1023.
codeApi.analogWrite: Sets a PWM level from 0 to 255.
codeApi.delay: Pauses the program for some milliseconds.
codeApi.tone: Plays a note on a buzzer.
codeApi.noTone: Stops the note on a pin.
codeApi.map: Converts a number from one range to another.
codeApi.constrain: Keeps a number between a minimum and a maximum.
codeApi.random: A random number from min up to max minus one.
codeApi.Serial_begin: Starts serial communication at a speed in bauds.
codeApi.Serial_print: Sends a value to the serial monitor.
codeApi.Serial_println: Sends a value and starts a new line.

compilerHelp.notDeclared: The name "{{name}}" is used but was never created. Check that it is spelled exactly the same everywhere, including capital letters, or declare it first.
compilerHelp.missingSemicolon: A semicolon (;) is missing at the end of the previous instruction.
compilerHelp.missingClosingBrace: A closing brace } is missing. Every { needs its own }.
compilerHelp.missingParenthesis: A closing parenthesis ) is missing. Count the ( and the ) on that line.
compilerHelp.notAType: "{{name}}" is not a known type. You may be missing an #include at the top, or the name is misspelled.
compilerHelp.missingLibrary: The library {{name}} is not installed. Install it or check the name in the #include.
compilerHelp.redefinition: "{{name}}" is defined twice. Each name can only be created once.
compilerHelp.wrongArguments: A function was called with the wrong number of values between the parentheses.
compilerHelp.strayCharacter: There is a strange character in the code, often curly quotes or symbols copied from a web page. Retype that line by hand.
compilerHelp.unterminatedText: A text is missing its closing quote ".
compilerHelp.assignInsteadOfCompare: To compare two values use == (two equal signs). A single = changes a value.
compilerHelp.elseWithoutIf: There is an else without its if. Check the braces { } of the if before it.
compilerHelp.typeMismatch: A value of one type was used where a different type is needed.
compilerHelp.incompleteExpression: An operation is incomplete: a value is missing before a symbol.
compilerHelp.unexpectedText: There is something unexpected outside a function. Check for an extra brace or text out of place.
compilerHelp.missingSetupOrLoop: Every program needs the function {{name}}(). Make sure it exists and is spelled correctly.
compilerHelp.programTooBig: The program does not fit in the board's memory. Try removing text or unused parts, or use a board with more memory.

uploadHelp.linuxPermission: Your user is not allowed to use the USB port. On Linux, add your user to the "dialout" group and sign in again.
uploadHelp.portBusy: The port is being used by another program, such as another serial monitor or the Arduino IDE. Close it and try again.
uploadHelp.portMissing: The board was not found on that port. Check the USB cable and choose the port again.
uploadHelp.espBootMode: The ESP32 did not enter upload mode. Hold down the BOOT button on the board while uploading.
uploadHelp.notInSync: The board did not answer. Check that the right board is selected. Many Nano clones need "Arduino Nano (old bootloader)".

help.drivers: Low-cost boards may need a driver (CH340 or CP210x).
